resources.label: VI Department of Human Services
resources.note: Cash, food (SNAP) and energy assistance for the territory. St. Thomas office 340-774-0930. USVI services are territory-wide across St. Croix, St. John and St. Thomas. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: VI Department of Health — Behavioral Health Division
resources.note: Weekday behavioural health services, 8am-5pm Monday to Friday. For nights and weekends call 988. USVI services are territory-wide across St. Croix, St. John and St. Thomas. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.note: Free and confidential, 24 hours. Call or text 988. Available in every US territory. Spanish available. USVI services are territory-wide across St. Croix, St. John and St. Thomas. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.note: 24 hours, free, confidential. Text START to 88788. They know what is open tonight and can talk through a safety plan. USVI services are territory-wide across St. Croix, St. John and St. Thomas. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: National Runaway Safeline
resources.note: For anyone under 18 with nowhere to go tonight, and for anyone worried about them. 24 hours, free, confidential. USVI services are territory-wide across St. Croix, St. John and St. Thomas. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.

resources.label: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.note: Dial 988 then press 1, or text 838255. For veterans, service members and their families. USVI services are territory-wide across St. Croix, St. John and St. Thomas. Verified 2026-08-01 — please call to confirm before you travel.
